expected.summary: About ten minutes before the anchor the feature flag auth.sync_revocation_check flipped from false to true on auth; the only marker is a config.change log on each auth pod, and no pod changed version. With the flag on, auth.verify checks the token revocation list synchronously on every request, so auth latency rose from about 20 ms to about 110 ms and around 1.5% of calls fail with RevocationCheckError: revocation list fetch timed out, logged as ERROR on auth. auth sits on every route, so the errors and the added latency propagate through web-bff and mobile-bff to edge-gateway on all routes at once, where the alert fires. There was no deploy, and the sessions Redis is unchanged.
contributingFactors: synchronous revocation check adding latency and timing out on every route
